适用.meaning: (of a rule) to apply to; to be applicable
适用.notes: English "apply" is four Chinese verbs. Apply FOR a job or permit = 申请. Apply a method TO a task = 应用/运用. Apply cream to skin = 抹/敷. A rule applies TO a case = 适用 — the only one with no agent, and it always takes 于. Written and legal: 适用范围 · 同样适用 · 本条不适用 · 适用法律.

应用.meaning: to apply (a method, a technology); application
应用.notes: You are the agent: you 应用 a method or a technology to a task. 应用于 · 应用到实际中 · 广泛应用 · 应用题 word problem · 应用程序 app. A rule 适用于 a case and has no agent. 运用 is the same act on knowledge or skill. Applying FOR a job is 申请, never 应用.

运用.meaning: to apply (knowledge, a skill); to put to use
运用.notes: The object is something you know, not something you hold: 运用知识/理论/技巧 · 灵活运用. 应用 leans technical and takes 于; 使用 is using a tool or object; 利用 is making use of, sometimes to exploit. All four come out as "apply" or "use" in English, which is why they blur.

予以.notes: Written light verb before a disyllabic noun-like object: 予以支持/考虑/答复 · 予以处分. 加以 is its twin and takes a verb instead — 加以修改. It is not the "apply" of 应用 or 适用, despite the dictionary listing that word.

加以.meaning: (written) to apply (an action) to what was just named
加以.notes: Written. Before a disyllabic verb whose object was already named — that verb takes none of its own: 需要加以修改 · 加以限制/说明/改进. 予以 is its twin and takes a noun-like object instead: 予以支持.
